00033 {
00034   options.clear();
00035   ifstream fileIn(optionsFile);
00036   if(fileIn.good()==false) {
00037          cerr<<"wrong option file"<<endl;        exit(1);

00040   while(fileIn.good()) {

00042          options[name] = string(content);
00043          fileIn>>name;
